input.code:
var py = `
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
import json, os

FONT = "Liberation Sans"
DARK = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
ACCENT = RGBColor(0x0B, 0x5E, 0xA8)
GREY = RGBColor(0x55, 0x5F, 0x70)
LIGHT = RGBColor(0xEC, 0xF2, 0xFA)

QUIZ = [
 dict(topic="Force", q="What is the SI unit of force?",
      ch=["Joule (J)", "Watt (W)", "Newton (N)", "Pascal (Pa)"], ans="C",
      exp="Force is measured in newtons. 1 N = 1 kg.m/s^2, the force that gives a 1 kg mass an acceleration of 1 m/s^2. Joule = energy, watt = power, pascal = pressure."),
 dict(topic="Force", q="A net force of 12 N acts on a 4 kg box on a frictionless floor. What is the acceleration of the box?",
      ch=["3 m/s\\u00b2", "0.33 m/s\\u00b2", "16 m/s\\u00b2", "48 m/s\\u00b2"], ans="A",
      exp="Newton's second law: F = m x a, so a = F / m = 12 N / 4 kg = 3 m/s^2, in the same direction as the net force."),
 dict(topic="Motion", q="A car moves at a steady speed and covers 150 m in 10 s. What is its speed?",
      ch=["1.5 m/s", "15 m/s", "160 m/s", "1500 m/s"], ans="B",
      exp="Speed = distance / time = 150 m / 10 s = 15 m/s (about 54 km/h)."),
 dict(topic="Motion", q="Which statement best describes an object that is moving with constant velocity?",
      ch=["Its acceleration is steadily increasing", "It must be at rest", "Its direction keeps changing", "The net force acting on it is zero"], ans="D",
      exp="Constant velocity means constant speed AND constant direction, so acceleration = 0. By Newton's first law the forces are balanced: net force = 0."),
 dict(topic="Energy", q="A 1 kg book rests motionless on a shelf 2 m above the floor. Which form of energy does it mainly store?",
      ch=["Kinetic energy", "Gravitational potential energy", "Sound energy", "Thermal energy"], ans="B",
      exp="Stored energy due to height: E_p = m x g x h = 1 kg x 9.8 N/kg x 2 m = about 20 J. The book is not moving, so it has no kinetic energy."),
 dict(topic="Energy", q="A 2 kg ball travels at 3 m/s. What is its kinetic energy?",
      ch=["3 J", "6 J", "9 J", "18 J"], ans="C",
      exp="KE = 1/2 x m x v^2 = 0.5 x 2 kg x (3 m/s)^2 = 9 J. Remember to square the speed before halving."),
]

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
blank = prs.slide_layouts[6]

def add_tb(slide, l, t, w, h):
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(l), Inches(t), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    return tb, tf

for i, item in enumerate(QUIZ, start=1):
    s = prs.slides.add_slide(blank)
    # top accent bar
    from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
    bar = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, Inches(0.9))
    bar.fill.solid(); bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
    bar.line.fill.background()
    bar.shadow.inherit = False
    tf = bar.text_frame; tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = Inches(0.35); tf.margin_top = Inches(0.1)
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]; p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.LEFT
    r = p.add_run(); r.text = "Basic Physics Quiz  |  Topic: %s" % item["topic"]
    r.font.size = Pt(20); r.font.bold = True; r.font.name = FONT
    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)

    # question number (right side of bar)
    _, tf2 = add_tb(s, 10.2, 0.16, 2.9, 0.6)
    p = tf2.paragraphs[0]; p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.RIGHT
    r = p.add_run(); r.text = "Question %d of %d" % (i, len(QUIZ))
    r.font.size = Pt(18); r.font.bold = True; r.font.name = FONT
    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)

    # question text
    _, tfq = add_tb(s, 0.7, 1.25, 11.9, 1.3)
    p = tfq.paragraphs[0]
    r = p.add_run(); r.text = "Q%d. %s" % (i, item["q"])
    r.font.size = Pt(28); r.font.bold = True; r.font.name = FONT; r.font.color.rgb = DARK

    # choices
    _, tfc = add_tb(s, 1.1, 2.75, 11.3, 2.6)
    letters = "ABCD"
    for j, ch in enumerate(item["ch"]):
        p = tfc.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else tfc.add_paragraph()
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        r = p.add_run(); r.text = "%s.  %s" % (letters[j], ch)
        r.font.size = Pt(24); r.font.name = FONT; r.font.color.rgb = DARK

    # footer hint (keeps lower area of slide free for OpenBoard annotations)
    _, tff = add_tb(s, 0.7, 6.75, 11.9, 0.5)
    p = tff.paragraphs[0]
    r = p.add_run(); r.text = "Choose one answer (A-D). The solution will be revealed by the teacher."
    r.font.size = Pt(14); r.font.italic = True; r.font.name = FONT; r.font.color.rgb = GREY

out = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/physics_quiz.pptx")
prs.save(out)
print("saved", out)
json.dump(QUIZ, open(os.path.expanduser("~/quiz.json"), "w"), indent=1)
print("slides:", len(prs.slides.__iter__.__self__._sldIdLst))
`;

var chk = `
import re, html, subprocess, zipfile, io, os
ubz = "/home/user/Desktop/physics_quiz.ubz"
z = zipfile.ZipFile(ubz)
names = sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if re.match(r"page\\d+\\.svg$", n))
print("UBZ pages:", len(names))
for idx, n in enumerate(names, start=1):
    s = z.read(n).decode("utf-8")
    # question text from the corresponding PDF page
    q = subprocess.run(["pdftotext","-f",str(idx),"-l",str(idx),"/home/user/Desktop/physics_quiz.pdf","-"],
                       capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    qlines = [l.strip() for l in q.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    ans = re.findall(r"<itemTextContent>(.*?)</itemTextContent>", s, re.S)
    txt = ""
    if ans:
        raw = html.unescape(ans[0])
        txt = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", raw)
        txt = re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", txt).strip()
    cur = re.findall(r"<ub:curtain[^>]*/>", s)
    n_text = len(re.findall(r'ub:type="text"', s))
    n_edit = len(re.findall(r'ub:editable="true"', s))
    pdfbg = "pdf#page=" in s
    print("="*90)
    print("PAGE %d  | text items: %d | editable: %d | curtains(Mask): %d | pdf background: %s"
          % (idx, n_text, n_edit, len(cur), pdfbg))
    print("  QUESTION:", " ".join(qlines[1:3])[:110])
    print("  CHOICES :", " | ".join([l for l in qlines if re.match(r"^[A-D]\\.", l)]))
    print("  ANNOT   :", txt[:190])
print("="*90)
print("metadata:", [n for n in z.namelist() if not n.startswith("page")][:8])
`;
